hlslLsp.general.fileExtensions.title: HLSL file extensions
hlslLsp.general.fileExtensions.description: Semicolon-separated file extensions to treat as HLSL. The built-in .hlsl and .hlsli extensions are always supported.

hlslLsp.general.languageVersion.title: Default HLSL language version
hlslLsp.general.languageVersion.description: The default DXC -HV value. A shadertoolsconfig.json languageVersion setting takes precedence.
